findings.body: The previous metadata gap remains open. Autoreview updates `selected` and activity records here, but the lane entry retains the `chosen` snapshot from review.py:509. Worker fallback similarly changes `chosen` at worker.py:165 without updating the entry. Both reader paths join using `repo.models` at story.py:222–231; repo.py:411–419 permits an empty selection, while provider-confirmed selections at repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386 update only activity records. Consequently, running entries can display null or obsolete model/effort values. Refresh the shared entry whenever a provider confirms or changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

Complete these there; this remains advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
